name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Good evening. Here's where the Falcons sit: Tua and Penix are still competing for that starting job, nothing's decided.

name: BIG MIKE VEGA
line: Renee, you're right...this isn't just a quarterback battle, it's the SEASON-LONG SHOWDOWN under a new head coach! The entire evaluation year rides on this decision!

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Mm.

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: Well, look, Renee, it's still an open competition, right? Tua's got the practice edge because Penix isn't cleared for 11-on-11 just yet.

name: BIG MIKE VEGA
line: Andrew, you're right about the open competition, but with a proven coach like Kevin Stefanski calling the shots, this evaluation year is the ULTIMATE MARQUEE EVENT!

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Right.

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: And look, Renee, it’s not just the practice reps; DC Stewart Show Podcast folks are saying Tua’s a seasoned veteran, consistent out there. That's a real advantage.

name: BIG MIKE VEGA
line: Right.

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Mm.

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Right.

name: BIG MIKE VEGA
line: Locked On Falcons calls the NFC South weak, and that makes this quarterback battle the CHAMPIONSHIP ROUND!

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Mike, division strength doesn't answer the actual question. Locked On Falcons itself says the front office won't tip its hand on who wins this job.

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: And Renee, that's fair, but you gotta remember, Penix is actually ahead of schedule, practicing without that knee brace. That's a real curveball for the competition.

name: BIG MIKE VEGA
line: Ahead of schedule? That just turns up the heat! But walking into a proven Stefanski offense for a full evaluation year? That's the pressure cooker, and it's STILL boiling!

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: Look, Mike, even with that pressure, DC Stewart Show Podcast folks also point out Tua’s issues in Miami weren't all on him, so there's some grace there.

name: BIG MIKE VEGA
line: Andrew, in a weak NFC South, grace is a luxury they can't afford! The door is WIDE OPEN, and not solving this QB riddle means another missed championship!

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Both of you are debating who wins a job the front office won't even confirm exists yet.

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: No, Renee, it’s about 2026. If the coaching staff and personnel were part of Tua’s past issues, that means it’s not settled for the future, right?

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: Fair question, and here's the risk: Locked On Falcons flags 2027 as the off-ramp, but they still don't know if Penix is the answer or if they draft again.

name: ANDREW HAMMOND
line: Well, Renee, you're right, that's the whole ballgame. If they're still asking if Penix is the guy or if they're back in the draft pool, it tells you 2026 is still an open question.

name: RENEE VAUGHN
line: That's the through-line, Andrew, and it means the season itself hinges on a question nobody's answered yet.
